metadata.title: chore(tests): improve unit test coverage toward 90% total
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- Push overall unit test coverage from ~85% to **91%** (branch coverage)
- Add **17 new test files** and extend **31 existing test files** across services, routers, middleware, plugins, and transports
- ~28,000 new lines of test code covering error paths, edge cases, and branch conditions
- Raise CI coverage threshold to 90% and add `diff-cover` for PR-level coverage enforcement

## Key coverage improvements

| Module | Before | After |
|--------|--------|-------|
| `services/tool_service.py` | 75% | 88% |
| `services/team_management_service.py` | 87% | 100% |
| `services/team_invitation_service.py` | 83% | 100% |
| `routers/teams.py` | ~70% | 100% |
| `plugins/framework/base.py` | 78% | ~95% |
| `plugins/framework/external/mcp/client.py` | 79% | ~85% |
| `plugins/framework/external/mcp/server/runtime.py` | 82% | ~90% |
| `plugins/framework/manager.py` | 90% | ~95% |
| `plugins/framework/models.py` | 92% | ~95% |

## New test files (17)
- `test_encryption_service.py`, `test_metrics.py`, `test_oauth_manager.py`, `test_permission_service.py`, `test_security_logger.py`, `test_sso_service.py`, `test_structured_logger.py`, `test_token_storage_service.py`
- `test_team_management_service_coverage.py` (62 tests), `test_team_invitation_service_coverage.py` (8 tests)
- `test_teams_coverage.py` (42 tests), `test_well_known.py`
- Plugin framework: `test_plugin_base_coverage.py`, `test_client_coverage.py`, `test_runtime_coverage.py`, `test_manager_coverage.py`, `test_plugin_models_coverage.py`

## Extended test files (31)
- Services: `tool_service` (+66 tests), `gateway_service`, `a2a_service`, `import_service`, `resource_service`, `prompt_service`, `server_service`, `mcp_client_chat_service`, `mcp_session_pool`, `catalog_service`, and more
- Routers: `reverse_proxy`, `llm_admin_router`, `llm_proxy_router`, `llmchat_router`
- Middleware: `rbac`, `request_logging_middleware`, `token_scoping_extra`
- Other: `test_admin`, `test_config`, `test_llm_schemas`, `test_schemas_validators_extra`, `test_streamablehttp_transport`, `test_validators_advanced`

## CI changes
- `pyproject.toml`: raise `fail_under` coverage threshold to 90%
- `.github/workflows/pytest.yml`: add `diff-cover` step for PR-level coverage gating
- `Makefile`: add `coverage report -m --no-skip-covered` to `coverage:` target

## Other
- Remove unused `mcpgateway/validators.py`
- Fix 29 pre-existing test failures (incorrect mock paths and assertions)

commits.message:
chore(ci): raise coverage threshold to 90% and add diff-cover

- Raise --cov-fail-under from 80% to 90% in CI pytest step
- Add diff-cover (>=9.0.0) to enforce 90% coverage on changed lines per PR
- Add diff-cover CI step (PRs only) comparing against base branch
- Change checkout fetch-depth to 0 so diff-cover can access full git history
- Add `make diff-cover` target for local usage

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
